Fixtures for ps3_resign.rs, taken from saves written by a real converter (NPUB, world 'ps3').
a_*: PARAM.SFO, METADATA and PARAM.PFD of one save; a_random.bin = iv(16) hash_key(20) entry_key0(64) entry_key1(64).
e_*: METADATA of a second save and its plaintext entry key; GAMEDATA was 9511997 bytes (crc32 d6151342),
the icon 7093 bytes (crc32 1dfa0b85).
